The two JSON files in this directory (equipment.json and monsters.json) are
copies of files from the weirdgloop/osrs-dps-calc repository at
https://github.com/weirdgloop/osrs-dps-calc, vendored unchanged at:

  https://raw.githubusercontent.com/weirdgloop/osrs-dps-calc/main/cdn/json/

That upstream project is licensed under the GNU General Public License v3.0.
Copies of the upstream LICENSE and AUTHORS files (if you need them) can be
fetched from the same repository. Use of this data in any redistribution
should preserve attribution to the upstream maintainers.

To refresh these files, run `npm run refresh-vendor` from the project root.
